invariants: identifier is stable within a definition version
semantic mutation requires a new explicit version
implementation cannot redefine the class it claims to implement
meta_definition.substrate_boundary: semantic control plane; not itself evidence of runtime implementation
meta_definition.executable_role: governs symbol resolution, admissible transformations, and conformance validation
proof_conditions: instance validation references exact definition identifier/version
invalid_interpretations: agent may silently reinterpret established identifiers

invariants: corpus is evidence/source, not reply generator
IL-LLM.substrate_boundary: semantic/runtime layer; independent of a specific LLM or corpus storage implementation
IL-LLM.executable_role: resolve identities/relations and produce traversable semantic state
proof_conditions: reply/assertion derives from resolved identities and typed relations
no hard-coded corpus concatenation substitutes for traversal

KEX.substrate_boundary: execution/address semantics, not a claim of literal physical hardware replacement
KEX.executable_role: govern admissible state transitions and address resolution
invalid_interpretations: zero silently used as weighted state

invariants: VFS does not become the encoded medium
VFS.executable_role: resolve logical names/paths to encoded machine objects

invariants: storage semantics may move independently of physical substrate
K-DRIVE.substrate_boundary: software-defined storage semantics over existing or future physical substrate
K-DRIVE.executable_role: provide substrate-independent storage identity and traversal semantics
invalid_interpretations: generic virtual disk with no authored semantic contract

invariants: BRAINK identity is not an IP address
BRAINK.substrate_boundary: software/runtime identity and orchestration; carrier machine is not the conceptual definition
BRAINK.executable_role: coordinate machine state, agents, semantic resolution, persistence, and services
invalid_interpretations: detached application bolted onto machine without registration

invariants: coordinate zero != state zero without explicit mapping
Observer.substrate_boundary: state/representation layer, not merely a UI dashboard
Observer.executable_role: bind frame-dependent representation and validate cross-observer translation

invariants: seed identity is stable within version
Seed.substrate_boundary: construction/bootstrap semantics, not merely a compressed archive
Seed.executable_role: instantiate a larger valid structure from a minimal encoded contract
